name: Planner
desc: Connect this project to a planning backend and map OurDashboard project structure to that system.
visibleData: Plans, boards, buckets, tasks, assignments, due dates, labels, status.
controlledActions: Convert OurDashboard phases/tasks into the backend planner structure and sync selected task changes.

name: Calendar
desc: Connect project dates, meetings, reminders, and delivery checkpoints.
visibleData: Calendars, events, attendees, reminders, deadlines, recurring meetings.
controlledActions: Create/read selected events and attach milestones to project phases.

name: Gantt
desc: See project phases and task timing as a schedule view.
visibleData: Phase windows, task dates, dependencies, slippage, critical path notes.
controlledActions: Create/update selected schedule records and map phase timing.

name: Kanban
desc: View project work as columns and work-in-progress lanes.
visibleData: Task status, lane, owner, blocked items, work-in-progress.
controlledActions: Move selected tasks between lanes and update status.

name: Risks
desc: Track risks, blockers, mitigations, and decision pressure.
visibleData: Risks, severity, likelihood, owner, mitigation status.
controlledActions: Create/update selected risk records and attach them to phases.

name: Decisions
desc: Record project decisions and why they were made.
visibleData: Decisions, rationale, approvers, dates, source notes.
controlledActions: Promote notes into decisions and link decisions to phases.

name: Users
desc: See all users who have been associated with this project.
controlledActions: Assign roles, mark owners, connect users to modules.

name: Cloudflare
desc: See Cloudflare resources associated with this project.
visibleData: Domains, DNS records, Workers, Pages, D1, KV, routes.
controlledActions: Create/read selected DNS, deployment, and Worker metadata.

name: Firebase
desc: See Firebase systems for this project.
visibleData: Apps, Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions, hosting targets.
controlledActions: Read/write selected project config and deployment records.

name: GitHub
desc: See repo data, GitHub Pages status, issues, and project activity.
visibleData: Repos, branches, issues, PRs, deployments, Pages status.
controlledActions: Create issues, update labels, link commits, read deployment state.

name: Stripe
desc: See Stripe data related to this project.
controlledActions: Read selected billing objects and map them to project records.

name: Files
desc: See relevant files on your local system for this project.
visibleData: Local folders, docs, exports, specs, screenshots, artifacts.
controlledActions: Open, index, tag, and attach selected local files.

name: MCP
desc: See MCP endpoint actions available for this project.
visibleData: Servers, tools, actions, schemas, permissions, health checks.
controlledActions: Run selected safe actions and record outputs.

name: OurBrain
desc: See relevant AI brain memories connected to this project.
visibleData: Memories, summaries, decisions, source references, embeddings.
controlledActions: Attach, update, distill, and retrieve selected memory records.
